# Teacher checkpoints — separate, not access-protected
Diagnostic checkpoints: P1 gives [[0,7],[0,7]] because both outer entries reference the same inner row. P2 uses middle indices 2 (value 9), then 3 (value 12), and returns 3; input must be sorted, comparable and nondecreasing. P3 gives [2,4,5,2] after inserting 4; strict > shifts only larger keys, preserving equal-key order. P4 dispatch uses each object's override; underscores signal intended internal use without enforcing access security or database constraints. D1: COUNT(*) includes an outer placeholder, while a NULL child LoanID is not counted; a NULL ReturnDate on the placeholder is not an active loan. D2: explicit rollback removes the earlier operation; a memory-only experiment cannot establish crash durability. N1: usable addresses are 192.168.40.65–94 and broadcast is .95; the first Ethernet link normally uses the next-hop gateway MAC. S1: TLS connection assurances differ from application authority; recipient, unauthorised disclosure, likely serious harm, remedial effects and entity coverage need investigation. Use the explanation for each idea to decide what needs another attempt.

A: The supplied Python reference demonstrates the contracts. row_totals is O(number of cells plus rows), or O(r × c) for non-empty rectangular grids. Construct independent inner rows. Binary search uses O(log n) comparisons under its precondition; sorting or maintaining input adds cost. Any matching duplicate index is acceptable. Insertion sort has O(n) best-case and O(n²) worst-case comparisons; strict > makes this implementation stable. Typical selection-sort swaps can be unstable; bubble sort can be stable with strict adjacent comparisons, and early exit depends on implementation. A shallow sorted copy preserves original list order but shares element objects. Session methods reject bad or full input, but this model does not protect direct attribute mutation or concurrent bookings. Polymorphic locations are Room, Online and Outdoor for the relevant objects.

B: The five-table schema supplies PK/FK/domain checks, not every business rule. Initial total/active reports: R01 2/1, R02 1/1, R03 1/0, R04 0/0. Active labels are PersonA / Camera and PersonA / Microphone, both in Media. The given single-column LoanID has no partial dependency on part of that key; repeated resource, category and member names create transitive dependencies. ReturnDate is optional; valid dates, chronology and no overlapping active loans need further enforcement. Two R01 loans and two inspections yield four joined rows; aggregate each child collection before joining. Explicit rollback is needed to preserve the intended all-or-nothing operation after a failed second statement. Check foreign_keys on each SQLite connection and verify unaffected rows.

C: Allocate 192.168.40.0/26, usable .1–.62, broadcast .63, gateway .1; 192.168.40.64/27, usable .65–.94, broadcast .95, gateway .65; and 192.168.40.96/28, usable .97–.110, broadcast .111, gateway .97. Capacities 62/30/14 meet totals 60/28/12 including gateways. State prefixes, avoid overlap and use course diagram conventions. The hostname case suggests a lookup problem; obtain the actual resolver result, configuration and name mapping rather than inferring the cause from ping. For a remote destination, the first Ethernet frame normally addresses the gateway. Routers replace link headers; IP endpoints usually persist unless a mechanism such as NAT changes them. A port number does not prove TLS; no actual packets are generated.

D: Trust server-authenticated identity and verified role/ownership; deny Learner all-export while preserving authorised workflow. Logs, response and tested backups have different purposes. Labels, IP addresses and counts do not prove a person or disclosure. Certificates contain public information; private-key possession and authenticated agreement have distinct roles, and symmetric AEAD protects records. A hash is not reversible encryption or author proof. Map APPs 5/8/10/11/12 appropriately; access is not correction (APP 13). Coverage, dates and eligibility facts matter; 30 days is an assessment period, not a notification waiting period. State provisions have separate commencement dates. Removing names can leave re-identification risk; attribution does not grant licence permission.

Transfer: T1 totals are [3,2], empty input gives [], and the ragged input raises ValueError. Changing one independently created row leaves the other unchanged. Searching for missing 16 uses middle indices 2 (8), 4 (14), 5 (17), then returns −1. Stable tuple output is [('B',1),('A',2),('C',2)]. T2: remaining capacity becomes 0 after the first reservation; the second raises ValueError. Outdoor uses the same location interface. T3: R04 becomes total 1/active 1; its new active label is PersonB / Switch, category Network; other rows are unchanged. A second R01 inspection multiplies its loan join to four rows. T4: 192.168.70.0/25 has usable .1–.126, broadcast .127, gateway .1; 192.168.70.128/27 has usable .129–.158, broadcast .159, gateway .129. Totals 70/20 include gateways. T5: established eligibility invokes authorised scheme notification; suspicion requires prompt assessment. T6: repair outer-join counts, preserve unknown attendance, enforce the actual network boundary and independently check application permission. Accept reasoned equivalent tests and stated limitations.

Keep criteria and evidence distinct. Review visual symbols and current law. This sampled consolidation does not complete a syllabus audit or guarantee examination readiness.
